name: TUM RGB-D
summary: 手持和机器人 RGB-D 序列配有运动捕捉轨迹，包含动态人群场景和连续相机运动。
summaryEn: Handheld and robot RGB-D sequences with motion-capture trajectories, including dynamic people and continuous camera motion.
scale: RGB-D at 30 Hz, 640 x 480; motion capture at 100 Hz
scaleZh: RGB-D 为 30 Hz、640 x 480；运动捕捉为 100 Hz
organizations: Technical University of Munich and University of Freiburg
organizationsZh: 慕尼黑工业大学与弗赖堡大学
license: Data: CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise; code: BSD-2-Clause
licenseZh: 数据默认 CC BY 4.0；代码为 BSD-2-Clause
access: Official sequence downloads and trajectory evaluation tools
accessZh: 官方序列下载和轨迹评估工具
wmNote: 连续 RGB-D 和真值位姿可支持未来观测与时空一致性分析；验证序列无公开真值。
wmNoteEn: RGB-D and pose sequences support future-view consistency analysis; validation sequences lack public ground truth.
